name: Sun Cleric: Holy Fervor already boosts Sunrise and Sunset by 20% (#1564)
contract: 300323 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), MiscValue 8 = SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x1000000 plus word 2 = 0x400000 combined into one 96-bit mask. Sunset (500511) carries word 1 = 0x1000000 in its own SpellFamilyFlags, and Sunrise (500477) carries word 2 = 0x400000 in its own -- the same one-mod-two-targets OR-combined mask pattern already used natively elsewhere in this class (e.g. Wrath of God). SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's generic flag96 AND matches both. BasePoints 19 resolves to 20 (DieSides 1), matching 'Increases the effectiveness of Sunrise and Sunset by 20%' exactly, applied through the ordinary SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS path in Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers. Native only, no server code needed.
